description: This Java source file defines the class 'FileBasedTenantBackend', which is a component in a tenant management system for a device registry service. It acts as a proxy to an underlying 'FileBasedTenantService', handling tenant-related API calls such as add, read, update, remove, and retrieval based on tenant IDs or distinguished names. It is part of the 'org.eclipse.hono.deviceregistry' package and uses frameworks like Spring for dependency injection and Vert.x for asynchronous operations.

classes.name: FileBasedTenantBackend
classes.description: A Vert.x verticle class implementing TenantBackend interface, acting as a proxy for tenant management operations backed by a file-based service.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new tenant with optional ID and tenant object, using tracing span and asynchronous result handler.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads tenant information based on tenant ID, with tracing span and result handler.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates tenant data identified by tenant ID with new tenant object, resource version, span, and result handler.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes tenant identified by tenant ID with optional resource version, span, and result handler.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves tenant information given tenant ID or distinguished name, via asynchronous handlers.
